title: Passing light
description: Thin streaks of light cross a quiet sky at different speeds.
useCase: Create a small atmospheric illustration or a contemplative cover.
interaction: Play or pause the passing lights
reducedMotion: The streaks become small stationary stars.
limitations: Decorative only; never conveys real progress or status. Nine deterministic streaks stay inside the example container.
look: Flat dark slate-blue field crossed by a few thin pale-blue diagonal streaks, each a dot head trailing a fading tail.
motion: Nine streaks fall from the top edge toward the lower right, each crossing 500 px linearly in 4–7 s on staggered infinite loops, fading over the final 30%.
adapt: Motion is the `mg-meteor-fall` keyframes (`rotate(-145deg)` sets the angle, `translateX(-500px)` the travel); the `meteors` array sets count, `left`, `duration` and `delay` per streak. Restyle `.mg-meteors-meteor` and its `::after` tail; keep the pause button and reduced-motion rule.
